methodology.highLimit: High-limit algorithm overhead is summarized separately from overload protection.
methodology.overloadProtection: Overload results describe behavior under the configured rate limits.
methodology.aggregation: Latency and throughput use medians of available report-level values. Response counts are summed only when the source values are available.
caveats: Results may come from different environments and configurations.
Legacy report schemas may expose different metrics.
Missing metrics remain null and are not assumed to be zero.
High-limit and overload results must not be combined into a single performance ranking.
This comparison script does not independently validate source report correctness.

warnings.warning: Legacy result data extracted from "rawResults". Verify its schema before relying on comparisons.
